title: Annual paid leave entitlement
questions: How many days of annual leave am I entitled to?
What is the annual vacation entitlement at Jana Group?
How many days of vacation do we have?
What is my yearly holiday allowance?
How much paid time off do employees get each year?
How many vacation days do employees get per year?
answer: Every employee is entitled to 20 paid vacation days per year. Vacation is counted in working days (Monday to Friday), so weekends are not counted.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: Checking your remaining vacation balance
questions: How many vacation days do I have left?
What is my remaining vacation balance?
Where can I find my vacation balance?
How many days of leave are still available to me?
Where do I look up how much leave I have remaining?
answer: Employees receive 20 working days of paid vacation per year. Your exact personal balance is shown on the Profile page of the Digital HR portal: it lists the days you have remaining and the days still available after pending requests.

source.docTitle: Руководство пользователя Digital HR (Digital HR Portal User Guide)

title: How to request vacation
questions: How do I request vacation?
How can I apply for leave in the portal?
What are the steps to book time off?
Where do I submit a vacation request?
How do I enter my holiday dates in the portal?
answer: Open the Digital HR portal, go to "My requests" and click "New request". Choose Vacation, pick your dates and submit.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: Request statuses and who approves
questions: Who approves my vacation request?
What happens after I submit a vacation request?
How does the approval process for leave work?
What do the request statuses mean?
What if I have no manager, who approves my request?
Can my manager reject my request and tell me why?
answer: A request moves from Submitted to In review (your direct manager picks it up) and then to Approved or Rejected. The manager can add a comment with the decision. HR can act on any request, and employees without a manager are approved by HR. You get a notification at every step.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: When vacation days are deducted
questions: When are vacation days deducted from my balance?
Are days taken off my balance when I submit or when it is approved?
What does pending mean for my vacation days?
Why is my available vacation lower than my remaining balance?
Do pending requests reduce my available days?
answer: Vacation days are deducted from your balance only when the request is finally approved. While a request is pending, its days are reserved: the portal shows "available" days as your remaining balance minus the pending days.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: Rules for vacation requests
questions: Can I request vacation for dates in the past?
Why won't the portal accept my vacation request?
Can two vacation requests overlap?
Can I ask for more days than I have available?
Which conditions must a vacation request meet?
answer: A vacation request cannot be in the past, cannot overlap another active request of yours, and cannot exceed your available days.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: How early to submit vacation
questions: How early should I submit a vacation request?
How far ahead should I ask for a long vacation?
Is there a minimum lead time for requesting leave?
How many weeks before my holiday should I apply?
Do I have to apply for time off beforehand?
answer: For vacation of 5 or more working days we recommend submitting the request at least 14 calendar days before it starts. This is a recommendation, not a requirement enforced by the portal.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: Cancelling a request
questions: How do I cancel a vacation request?
Can I withdraw a request after sending it?
I submitted a request by mistake, can I cancel it?
Until which status can I cancel my request?
Can I cancel my salary advance request?
answer: You can cancel your own request while it is Submitted or In review. Find the request under "My requests" and cancel it there.

source.docTitle: Руководство пользователя Digital HR (Digital HR Portal User Guide)

title: Carrying over unused vacation
questions: Can I carry over unused vacation days to the next year?
What happens to my leftover leave at the end of the year?
Do my unused vacation days expire?
Is it possible to roll over holiday days?
Until when can I use last year's vacation days?
answer: Up to 10 unused vacation days can be carried over to the next year. Carried-over days can be used until 31 March.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: Unpaid leave
questions: Can I take unpaid leave?
How many days of leave without pay are possible per year?
What is the process for unpaid vacation?
Who approves unpaid leave?
Is a leave of absence possible when my vacation days are used up?
answer: Unpaid leave of up to 14 days per calendar year is possible. It needs approval from both your direct manager and HR, so please contact HR to arrange it.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: Public holiday calendar
questions: Which public holidays does the company observe?
Where can I find the list of public holidays?
When is the holiday calendar published?
Does Jana Group follow the national holiday calendar?
Who publishes the calendar of public holidays?
answer: The company follows the official national public-holiday calendar. HR publishes it every December.

source.docTitle: Политика отпусков (Leave Policy)

title: What to do when you are sick
questions: What do I do when I am ill?
Who do I notify if I cannot come to work because I am unwell?
How do I report sick leave?
I woke up with a fever, what should I do?
How do I tell my manager that I am sick?
answer: Notify your direct manager on the same day, as early as you can. If the sickness continues, a medical certificate is required from the 3rd day.

source.docTitle: Политика больничных листов (Sick Leave Policy)

title: Medical certificate for sick leave
questions: Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
From which day is a medical certificate required?
How long can I be sick without a certificate?
Is a sick note necessary for a single day of illness?
Which documents do I need after being ill?
answer: A medical certificate is required from the 3rd day of sickness. Even for shorter absences you must notify your manager on the same day.

source.docTitle: Политика больничных листов (Sick Leave Policy)

title: Payment during sick leave
questions: Is sick leave paid?
How much do I get paid when I am sick?
Will I lose salary if I am ill?
How is sick leave compensated?
Who can tell me about payment for sick days?
answer: Payment for sick leave follows the national labour law. HR can advise you on how it applies to your case.

source.docTitle: Политика больничных листов (Sick Leave Policy)

title: Working hours
questions: What are our working hours?
When does the working day start and end?
How long is the lunch break?
How many hours per week do I have to work?
What time do we start in the morning?
answer: Standard working hours are 09:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, including a 1-hour lunch break. This makes a 40-hour working week.

source.docTitle: Политика рабочего времени и удаленной работы (Working Time & Remote Work Policy)

title: Remote work
questions: Am I allowed to work remotely?
What is the remote work policy?
How many days per week can I work from home?
Do I need approval to work from home?
Is hybrid work possible at Jana Group?
answer: Remote work is possible up to 2 days per week with your manager's approval.

source.docTitle: Политика рабочего времени и удаленной работы (Working Time & Remote Work Policy)

title: Overtime
questions: How does overtime work?
Will I be compensated for staying late at work?
Do I need permission before working extra hours?
How is overtime compensated?
answer: Overtime needs prior written approval from your manager. Approved overtime is compensated with time off.

source.docTitle: Политика рабочего времени и удаленной работы (Working Time & Remote Work Policy)

title: How to request a salary advance
questions: How can I get an advance on my salary?
Where do I apply for a salary advance?
What are the steps to ask for early salary?
Can I get part of my salary before payday?
Do I have to give a reason for an advance?
answer: Open the Digital HR portal, go to "My requests", click "New request" and choose Salary advance. Enter the amount and a reason (the reason is required), then submit.

source.docTitle: Политика оплаты труда и авансов (Payroll & Salary Advance Policy)

title: Salary advance limits
questions: How much of my salary can I get as an advance?
What is the maximum salary advance?
How many advance requests can I make per month?
Is there a limit for salary advances?
Can I ask for an advance twice in one month?
answer: An advance can be up to 50% of your monthly net salary. You can submit at most one advance request per calendar month.

source.docTitle: Политика оплаты труда и авансов (Payroll & Salary Advance Policy)

title: When an approved advance is paid
questions: When will I receive my approved advance?
How long does it take for the salary advance to be paid out?
How many days until an advance is paid after approval?
When does the advance money arrive?
answer: An approved salary advance is paid within 3 working days after approval.

source.docTitle: Политика оплаты труда и авансов (Payroll & Salary Advance Policy)

title: Salary payday
questions: On which day of the month is salary paid?
What is the payday?
When do I get my salary?
Which date does my pay arrive each month?
answer: Regular salary is paid on the 10th of each month.

source.docTitle: Политика оплаты труда и авансов (Payroll & Salary Advance Policy)

title: Where to find your payslip
questions: Where can I find my payslip?
How do I get my pay slip?
Can I see my salary slip in the portal?
Where do I download the payslip for last month?
Is the payslip available in Digital HR?
answer: Payslips are issued in 1C:ZUP, the payroll system. The portal will show them after the planned 1C:ZUP integration; until then, please ask HR for your payslip.

source.docTitle: Политика оплаты труда и авансов (Payroll & Salary Advance Policy)

title: Employment certificates and other documents
questions: How do I get an employment certificate?
Where can I request a certificate of employment?
I need a letter confirming that I work here
How can I get a document from HR?
How long does HR take to issue a certificate?
answer: Send your request to HR using the "Ask HR" option in Al Jana. HR issues employment certificates and other documents within 3 working days.

source.docTitle: Справочник жизненного цикла сотрудника (Employment Lifecycle Handbook)

title: Voluntary health insurance
questions: Does the company provide health insurance?
Is there medical insurance for employees?
When can I join the voluntary health insurance?
Am I covered by health insurance during probation?
answer: Voluntary health insurance is available to employees after the probation period.

source.docTitle: Руководство по льготам и бенефитам (Benefits Guide)

title: Annual learning budget
questions: Is there a budget for my professional development?
Can the company pay for an external training?
How much is my yearly learning budget?
Can I attend a conference at the company's expense?
answer: Every employee has an annual learning budget for external courses and conferences. Agree on how to use it with your manager first, and ask HR for the current amount.

source.docTitle: Политика обучения в Jana Academy (Jana Academy Training Policy)

title: Business trips and travel expenses
questions: How do I get approval for a business trip?
What do I need to do before going on a work trip?
How do I claim my travel expenses?
How long do I have to submit an expense report after a trip?
answer: Business trips need your manager's approval beforehand. After you return, submit your expense report within 5 working days.

source.docTitle: Политика командировок (Business Travel Policy)

title: Resignation and notice period
questions: How do I resign from the company?
How much notice do I need to give when I quit?
What is the procedure if I want to leave my job?
Do I have to resign in writing?
answer: Resignation requires 30 calendar days of written notice.

source.docTitle: Справочник жизненного цикла сотрудника (Employment Lifecycle Handbook)

title: Probation period
questions: How long is the probation period?
How long is the trial period for new colleagues?
When does my probation end?
What is the probationary period at Jana Group?
answer: The probation period for new employees is 3 months.

source.docTitle: Справочник жизненного цикла сотрудника (Employment Lifecycle Handbook)

title: Mandatory Jana Academy courses
questions: Which Jana Academy courses are mandatory?
How long do I have to finish my assigned mandatory training?
What is the deadline for compulsory courses?
Do I have to complete the Information Security course?
When is the Code of Conduct training due?
answer: The mandatory courses are Information Security Basics and Code of Conduct & Ethics. They must be completed within 30 days of assignment.

source.docTitle: Политика обучения в Jana Academy (Jana Academy Training Policy)

title: Course tests and pass mark
questions: What score do I need to pass a course test?
How do I pass a Jana Academy course?
Is there a minimum score for the academy exam?
Can I retake a failed test?
How many times can I retry a test?
Does every course end with a test?
answer: Every Jana Academy course ends with a test. The pass mark is 70%, and you can retake the test as many times as you need.

source.docTitle: Политика обучения в Jana Academy (Jana Academy Training Policy)

title: Where course results are recorded
questions: Where can I see my course results?
Where are my training results recorded?
How do I check whether I completed a course?
Where can I find my academy progress?
Are my test scores saved?
answer: Test results are recorded in the portal. You can see your courses, progress and results in the Academy section.

source.docTitle: Политика обучения в Jana Academy (Jana Academy Training Policy)

title: Contacting the HR team
questions: How can I contact the HR team?
What is the HR email address?
Who do I write to with an HR matter?
Where can I reach HR?
answer: You can reach the HR team at hr@jana.example. You can also ask Al Jana: if I cannot answer, I can forward your question to HR.

source.docTitle: Руководство пользователя Digital HR (Digital HR Portal User Guide)

title: What happens when Al Jana cannot answer
questions: What happens if Al Jana cannot answer my question?
Can you forward my question to HR?
How do I ask HR something that is missing from the knowledge base?
How does the Ask HR option work?
Will a real person answer my question?
answer: Al Jana answers only from the HR knowledge base. If there is no reliable answer, it says so and offers to pass your question on to the HR team, who answer it themselves.

source.docTitle: Руководство пользователя Digital HR (Digital HR Portal User Guide)

title: Notifications in the portal
questions: Where can I see my notifications?
How will I know when the status of my request changes?
Will I be notified when my vacation is approved?
Where do I read messages from the portal?
answer: You get a notification in the portal at every step of a request: submitted, in review, and approved or rejected. Open Notifications to read them.

source.docTitle: Руководство пользователя Digital HR (Digital HR Portal User Guide)

title: What you can do in the Digital HR portal
questions: What can I do in the Digital HR portal?
What features does the HR portal have?
Where can I see who my manager is?
What is the Digital HR portal for?
answer: In the Digital HR portal you can submit vacation and salary advance requests under "My requests", see your profile (including your direct manager and vacation balance), take Jana Academy courses, and read your notifications.

source.docTitle: Руководство пользователя Digital HR (Digital HR Portal User Guide)

title: December coverage in a branch
questions: Can the whole branch take December off together?
Can everyone in the branch go on vacation in December?
What if the whole team wants leave in December?
Is there a December rule about the branch all being away?
answer: In December a whole branch must not be away at the same time. If a request would leave nobody on site, the portal shows a warning. It does not reject the request: the manager still decides.
